clamp.assumptions: Long-channel linear-region order-of-magnitude estimate only; exact low-rail, contention and release require C2 measured currents. Tail bias approximately <=(3.2-0.61)/1e6=2.59uA per core at high rail.
clamp.pulse_termination: Unchanged vm/h comparator polarity, qb->h positive feedback and q->NMOS/Rdis discharge. Clamp overrides o1 only while actual por_hold is high. No gate inserted into feedback.
clamp.q_and_qb_consumers: Original q/qb inverter chain and all consumer wiring retained. A forced-low o1 makes q low and qb high, disabling PMOS-controlled recovery/activity/history charge switches.
